protocol.source: frozen 36D/K=28 detector and threshold selected on the source Fit/Calibration partitions
protocol.target: target's own clean-trained Mapping materializes Final Test features; no target Fit/Calibration fault labels are read
protocol.evaluation: target Final Test fault labels are used only after frozen prediction for offline scoring
protocol.strict_finite: all 36 target Final Test features finite after numeric cleaning; NaN, +/-Inf, and values beyond float32 range excluded
